children: reported record revenue for August on Thursday, driven by continued strong demand for chips used in artificial intelligence applications.
The world’s largest contract chipmaker posted revenue of NT$514.8B ($16.35B) for last month, up 53.3% from a year earlier and 10.1% from July.
Revenue for January through August totaled NT$3,386.87B, an increase of 39.3% compared to the same period in 2025, the go-to chipmaker for Nvidia
The Taiwanese tech giant reported a more than 77% year-on-year jump in second-quarter profit and forecast third-quarter revenue between $44.6B and $45.8B.

TSMC has maintained its dominance in the global foundry market, with a 72.5% market share in the second quarter, according to data released by TrendForce Wednesday. Strong demand for AI server processors kept TSMC’s advanced 5-, 4- and 3-nanometer capacity fully booked during the quarter, the research firm said. Samsung
Foundry ranked second with a 5.9% share, followed by China’s SMIC at 5.4%.

title: TSMC revenue jumps 53% in August as AI demand keeps capacity booked
